description: Frozen evaluation config for the WorldSense modality necessity/substitutability study. Contains no secrets.

model.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite
model.gateway_model_id_note: Exact identifier listed by GET /v1/models on the CMU AI Gateway (the only model exposed).

gateway.auth: standard OpenAI-compatible API key (sent per the OpenAI client convention); the key itself is read only from the environment variable below and never stored

media_request_format.message_layout: one user message; media content parts first (in condition order), then one text part with the v1 prompt
media_request_format.source: ChatCompletionFileObject / ChatCompletionFileObjectFile in the Gateway's GET /openapi.json (LiteLLM 1.103.4); InputAudio there only allows wav/mp3, so audio also uses the file part

gateway.media_request_format_note: Media is sent inline (base64), not by URL. MIME types per condition come from src/prompting.py CONDITION_MEDIA.

transient_retries_note: Re-send only after a failed attempt that returned no completion (HTTP 408/429/5xx, timeout, connection error), so a successful call is never duplicated. Every attempt, failed or not, is saved.
